speaker: Sheldon
text: I've lived up to all my commitments under the agreement. At least once a day I ask how you are, even though I simply don't care. I no longer stage spontaneous biohazard drills after 10 p.m. And I abandon my goal to master Tuvan throat singing. I'd be much further along if I'd been allowed to practice.

speaker: Leonard
text: Do you really expect to enforce this? Look, Sheldon, I know it's in the agreement. And if you turn into a zombie, I promise I will not kill you. In fact, I'll even let you eat my brains, but I am taking Penny to Switzerland.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Is that your final decision? Very well.

speaker: Penny
text: Okay, I know I shouldn't ask, but what is... It's not over, is it?

speaker: Leonard
text: Got a bit of traffic this morning, huh?
